title: Stardust

evidence.note: Carmichael composed the instrumental tune in 1927; Mills Music published it as piano sheet music on January 19, 1929. Mitchell Parish's vocal lyrics, the version the song is now famous for, were published May 10, 1929 as 'Star Dust' -- the later year is used because the famous version's lyrics postdate the tune.

famous_use: Artie Shaw's 1940 recording, a million-seller inducted into the Grammy Hall of Fame in 1988.
